ceu: ✦ The trine between Jupiter and Saturn

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
From {H:1806520791000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.

s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.

From {H:1806520791000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.

s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.

s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.
